title: Queryable attributes for lnd-fts-land-3 collection
description: This lists the attributes which can be filtered on and their types for lnd-fts-land-3 collection.

osid.description: Primary identifier for the feature. The OSID is a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) and requires no centralised authority to ensure uniqueness. Note that the same OSID can occur in more than one feature type when a single feature is represented multiple times in the OS NGD.

toid.description: Topographic identifier (TOID) of the feature, as published in the OS MasterMap suite of products.

geometry_area_m2.description: The measured area of the geometry in square metres.

description.description: A single descriptive value intended for a quick understanding of what the feature represents.

oslandcovertiera.description: A high-level description of the land cover; more detail is provided in the oslandcovertierb attribute.

oslandcovertierb.description: A detailed description of the land cover type. Up to five distinct land cover types can be applied.

landform.description: The nature of the land where it has been significantly altered by human activity and is still recognisable as such, for example, a former canal or areas of mineral workings.

oslandusetiera.description: A high-level description of the main activity that takes place at the location or that the feature supports.

oslandusetierb.description: A detailed description of the main activity that takes place at the location or that the feature supports.

status.description: The state of the feature in relation to either its physical condition or the activity the feature is intended to support.
